author: haiku
label: seeded-07r-01
changes: Rewrote the whole document once for a newcomer, keeping every fact from the brief and the first version. No junior questions or answers were supplied, so the rewrite is based on the brief and the first version alone.
Added a summary that first says how the system works today: keys read once from the committed file, copied into clients, baked into every image.
Added a terms section defining secret store, KMS, service identity, version id, replica, readiness probe, rolling deploy, APP_ENV, rotate and revoke.
Split the document into how the app runs (startup, refresh, rules) and how we build and roll out, as the skill requires.
Stated the non-secret config values that stay in config/app.yaml (port, log level, base URLs, timeouts, from address) so the file is not read as empty.
Merged the first version's steps 3, 4 and 5 into one code step, and said that clients call secrets.get() on each request so a refresh reaches them. A copy at construction would miss refreshes.
Made /healthz explicit: it returns 200 only after all three keys load, which the brief requires before ready, and it shows secret_versions.
Put the failure handling from the brief into each step, and added a short table only for cross-step cases.
Made the revoke order explicit: rotate, write the new version, wait until all 4 replicas show it, then revoke the old key.
Added a rollback rule: after revocation, an image from before the migration fails its provider calls, so rollback must stay on post-migration images. Added to the rollback notes step.
Kept the first version's 'don't log secret values' as a rule under the runtime section and kept its rotation-schedule question as an open question. No cadence was chosen.
Added open questions the brief leaves unsettled: missing-key handling, checking a new key before revoke, and who performs provider rotation.
Did not add locks, leases, retry queues or takeover rules, since the brief does not require them.
